prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. A 36-year-old adult son walks slowly through a small family garden with his 68-year-old mother and 72-year-old father. They chat and smile toward one another with relaxed arms and a natural pace. Simple garden beds and a modest fence stay softly behind them. Photograph their shared moment in soft early-evening light. Output a wide horizontal 16:9 composition for a website section. Keep every main person and key interaction centred closely enough to remain fully inside both a central 4:3 crop and a central 1.65:1 crop; scenery may extend to the outer edges. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct invented appearances: son has short sandy-blond hair, a trimmed light beard and a tall lean build; mother has short grey curls, dark eyes and a fuller build; father has a bald crown, silver hair at the sides, rectangular glasses and a stocky frame. Exactly these three people.
Composition priority: exact wide 16:9 aspect ratio. Step the camera back to an environmental medium-wide view. ALL main people, faces, arms, hands and key props must fit entirely in the central 55 percent of image width, leaving substantial believable room or scenery at BOTH sides.
review: Reviewed full wide image: exactly three relatives walk together in a garden, a sandy-haired adult son between a curly grey-haired mother and a balding father with glasses.
